explanation.headline: FDA's records show cyclophosphamide supplied from a plant with VAI inspections in 2018 and 2026; drug not on FDA shortage list today

sentences.text: The product label identifies Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (Jinqiao Road Site) as the manufacturing plant for cyclophosphamide labeled by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC.
FDA inspection 1053330 at that plant ended on 2018-04-13 and was classified VAI, with the classification known on 2018-06-14.
A more recent FDA inspection 1319132 at the same plant ended on 2026-04-15 and was also classified VAI, with the classification known on 2026-07-14.
Corvale East holds 54 units with 20 days on hand at current use, and Corvale General holds 63 units with 22 days on hand.

rejected.text: As of today 2026-10-21, cyclophosphamide does not appear on FDA's drug shortage list.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Avenacy, LLC, whose plant is EPIC PHARMA LLC; verify that this source is available and meets formulary requirements.

Q-e4dffa.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-7bfc24.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('31986d36-a1bf-4903-93a4-ce7386241ba1') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-835014.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-e7c999.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-6aa5e5.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-7258a8.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3006689263', '3006549835', '2431929') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-cd7f3d.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3006689263', '3006549835', '2431929') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-5fa029.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3006689263') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('jiangsu hengrui')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-66bc71.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('jiangsu hengrui', 'fresenius kabi') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-a71bd6.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('65219013320')

Q-6510df.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%cyclophosphamide%'
